clarity_hierarchy.critique: The primary action (START MISSION) is buried at the very bottom edge and partially cut off, so the screen's most important control has the least prominence. The three upgrade options (Damage / Fire Rate / Speed) required by the brief are not visible as a distinct row, leaving a core menu element missing from the reading flow. The top HUD (Wave/HP/Credits) and the 'TACTICAL VIEW' radar panel both carry strong visual weight and pull attention away from the briefing and the start action, creating multiple competing focal points.
